Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type 1b (BVDV-1b) __that is cytopathic__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the composition does not contain inactivated bacterial antigens__, and further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 1a (BVDV-1a), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the modified, live BVDV-1b virus is cytopathic__, and further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type 1a, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the composition does not contain inactivated bacterial antigens__, and further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __a viral antigen specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of__ Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __a viral antigen that is__ inactivated.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 4, __wherein the composition does not contain inactivated bacterial antigens__, and further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen.
